capabilities: consolidate all vault Markdown notes into one export note
run the export from a ribbon button or the Consolidate vault to PDF command
configure cover page, table of contents, and page breaks per note in an options modal
preserve folder hierarchy and link table-of-contents entries to sections
skip .obsidian content and delete previous temporary export notes
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. The README warns that PDF behavior, including link clickability, depends on Obsidian/Electron and the PDF viewer.
intentEvidence: combines markdown notes in your vault into one export note and starts Obsidian's PDF export flow
problem: Obsidian exports single notes to PDF, but has no built-in way to export the whole vault as one combined PDF document.
summary: Export plugin that consolidates all vault Markdown notes into one temporary document and runs Obsidian's PDF export flow on it.
